findings.description: The KMS key does not have enable_key_rotation set to true, meaning the key material will never be automatically rotated, increasing the risk associated with key compromise over time.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key policy is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default AWS-managed policy that grants full access to the entire AWS account (via IAM), which can allow overly broad access to encrypt/decrypt/manage the key if account IAM policies are permissive.
